latencyTarget: The overhead gate allows 50 ms p95 for local authorization (P1-22 risks); both versions measured above it here, on a loaded machine. The latency case measures tool_call only; tool_result outcomes are recorded after the call ran.

mutations.mutation: rule 1: a Pi outcome writer fault never counts as under a registration
killedBy: a writer fault while recording a registered session's tool outcome latches the workspace across a restart; only the owner's passphrase clears it
after a writer fault on a tool outcome, the extension blocks every later call of every session and tells Pi the workspace is latched

mutations.mutation: rule 2: control mode records a tool outcome at the observed ingress only (the original gap)
killedBy: after a writer fault on a tool outcome, the extension blocks every later call of every session and tells Pi the workspace is latched

mutations.mutation: rule 3: the client counts a 409 as recorded
killedBy: a call whose request observation conflicts with one already recorded is blocked and gets no decision

mutations.mutation: rule 3 (server): any repeat is answered as the same observation
killedBy: the same outcome re-sent is recorded once; a conflicting one is kept, flagged and refused
malformed, unauthenticated, conflicting, forwarder-reported or unregistered observations do not latch

mutations.mutation: rule 4: Pi decisions ignore intake backpressure
killedBy: outcomes over a session's cap are listed in a signed summary, and its calls are denied until the window passes

mutations.mutation: rule 4 (registrations): Pi registrations are not counted against the lease and workspace caps
killedBy: churned registrations cannot defeat the caps: one lease registers at most 30 Pi sessions a minute; a re-registration is not counted

mutations.mutation: rule 5: any Pi outcome writer fault counts as under a registration
killedBy: malformed, unauthenticated, conflicting, forwarder-reported or unregistered observations do not latch
